scope: Tiny paired local contracts;root-owned runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Validate the product before computing its digest
cases.input_contract: Require ordered fieldsid, value with bigint types, exactly 30 known unique IDs 0..29, known values equal to 2*id and total 870. ReturnSHA-256 of sorted SparkJSON lines joined by newline without a trailing newline.
cases.expected: A64-character lowercase digest for the valid product. Wrong values, counts, types or identities are rejected before hashing.
cases.verification: Assert a64-hex digest and equal digest after repartitioning;reject a31-row source.

cases.title: Stage a run and validate the persisted readback
cases.input_contract: Restrict run IDs to 1..32 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens. Validate input, write a fresh run-specific Parquet product, validate readback and save its receipt. If that run already exists, require its validated digest to match instead of appending.
cases.expected: run-a has one 30-row data product and a receipt with the declared schema/count/path/digest. Reusing it never appends another product.
cases.verification: Assert staged receipt existence and digest equality;all paths remain within the fresh owned root.

cases.title: Validate a receipt against a fixed owned data path
cases.input_contract: Read a run receipt and require its run_id, data_path, row_count, schema and digest to match the declared contract and actual Parquet readback. Construct the read path from validated runId rather than trusting arbitrary receipt text.
cases.expected: Validrun-a receipt returns unchanged. A traversal-style run ID is rejected before path access.
cases.verification: Assert receipt equality and explicit rejection of../outside.

cases.title: Publish only a validated run at one explicit visibility point
cases.input_contract: Validate the staged receipt, write it to a fresh temporary manifest beside current.json, and atomically replace current.json. Support an injected failure before replacement and clean any unpublished temporary manifest in finally.
cases.expected: Publishingrun-a creates current.json selecting its 30-row product. No data is appended or rewritten during publication.
cases.verification: Assert the current manifest equals the validated receipt and points torun-a.

cases.title: Keep the previous publication readable after an interrupted replacement
cases.input_contract: Read the current manifest, validate its selected run and return that product. Stage run-b, inject failure before its manifest replacement, and confirm the reader still seesrun-a.
cases.expected: The injected error occurs, current.json bytes remain identical torun-a, and the published product still has 30 rows with the original digest.
cases.verification: Assert the named exception, unchanged manifest and exact published product digest;run-b staging must not enter the reader population.

cases.title: Replay the same input without appending another product
cases.input_contract: Compose stage, validate/publish and readback for a repeated run ID. Retryrun-a with a different execution partition layout, then attempt an invalid 31-row product and confirm publication stays intact.
cases.expected: Manifest bytes and data-file count are unchanged by validrun-a replay;published count remains 30. Invalid input fails before changing current.json.
cases.verification: Assert digest, manifest bytes, file-count equality and negative-control rejection.

golden.publication_scope: Single-writer process-level atomic manifest replacement on prepared local filesystem;no distributed transaction or power-loss durability claim.
